discardMessage:
Discard changes to "{path}" (+{add}/−{del})?
This can't be recovered through Git. A snapshot will be saved automatically first.
undoAvailable: Snapshot saved — you can undo within 5 seconds from the toast.
ghNotAuthed: Not signed in to GitHub CLI
lastTurnTitle: Show only files changed by the agent this turn
noProject: No project folder selected yet. Open a project from the left sidebar first.
agentNoChange: The agent changed no files this turn
discardFileTitle: Discard this file's changes (snapshot first, undoable)
unstageFileTitle: Remove the whole file from the index (changes stay in the working tree)
unstageHunkTitle: Remove this hunk from the index; the change stays in the working tree
acceptHunkTitle: Stage only this hunk; other hunks stay unstaged
hunkDiscardMessage:
Discard this single hunk in "{path}"?
Unstaged changes cannot be recovered via Git, so a snapshot is taken first.
reviewHint: Review file by file, then commit
createPrTitle: Create a pull request via the local GitHub CLI
commentHunkTitle: Comment on this hunk; the agent will revise accordingly
commentPlaceholder: Describe what to change, e.g. "use const here"
commentSent: Comment submitted and sent to the agent as the next instruction
commentHint: Submitting triggers a new agent turn right away
